content.text: The insurance clause matches the preferred position in full.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 obliges Vendor (Silverline) to carry, at its own expense for the term plus one year, CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O of USD 2M and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M — meeting every limit in our preferred position (and exceeding the fallback of E&O 1M / cyber 2M), with employer's liability of USD 1M as an extra. Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, primacy over Customer's insurance, cancellation notice, and confirms insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. The clause runs entirely in our favour, so no redline is warranted.
